title: Mysterious Pyramid Chamber
description: A towering stepped pyramid with glowing circular portals on each level stands centrally, framed by an ornate mechanical metallic border with pipes and circuits. Small human figures are visible on the pyramid's terraces and near the glowing openings, set against a dark sky with green aurora borealis and mist.
prompt: A massive ancient stepped pyramid made of reddish stone with multiple large circular glowing portals showing different scenes inside, small human figures standing on the terraces and stairs, green aurora borealis in the dark sky above, surrounded by glowing mist and energy, all contained within an intricate mechanical metallic frame with pipes, gears and circuits, atmospheric and mysterious digital painting
